description: This file defines custom exception classes for FastAPI, extending Starlette exceptions, and includes validation error classes for use within FastAPI applications. It also contains example usage and links to FastAPI documentation.

classes.name: HTTPException
classes.description: Custom exception class for HTTP errors, extending Starlette's HTTPException, with additional annotations and documentation.

classes.name: WebSocketException
classes.description: Custom exception class for WebSocket errors, extending Starlette's WebSocketException, with added documentation.

classes.name: ValidationException
classes.description: Base class for validation errors, capturing error details and optional endpoint context information.

classes.name: RequestValidationError
classes.description: ValidationException for request body validation errors, includes optional body data.

classes.name: ResponseValidationError
classes.description: ValidationException for response validation errors, includes optional body data.

classes.name: PydanticV1NotSupportedError
classes.description: Error indicating that a Pydantic v1 model is used, which is no longer supported.

classes.name: FastAPIDeprecationWarning
classes.description: Custom warning class for deprecation notices within FastAPI.
